2026-11-18-cells-from-above.webp | The example room's cells of half a meter seen from above, each column the material of its topmost cell and the number its top in cells over the ground, the floor at none, the ramp rising to the platform at 2 and the walls at 8, the door under the wall above its doorway.
2026-11-18-example-room-sheet.webp | The example room as the module alone gives it, from build/sheet/room.sh: its meshes from above, north up, each face in the Materials module's prototype tone for its material, floor and wall one tone, and lighter the higher it stands, with its lights, the spot's way, the sun's and its entities marked; from an oblique eye to the south-east, the ramp, the platform and the door in its doorway; and the lux its point light and its spot give the floor by LevelLight.IlluminanceAt, 52 at the most under the spot.
2026-11-22-room-meshes.webp | The example room's brushes as the meshes made from them, from an oblique eye to the south-east, each face in the Materials module's prototype tone for its material and shaded flat by one sun, the ramp and the door in its doorway; the first picture of the README.
